died.name: William Hotman
died.cause: wounded at the Battle of Groton Heights, explaining to a friend how he would prevent the British from igniting a line of powder from the magazine of Fort Griswold
died.last_words: We will endeavor to crawl to this line; we will completely wet the powder with our blood: thus will we, with the life that remains in us, save the fort and the magazine, and perhaps a few of our comrades who are only wounded!

died.name: William Ledyard
died.desc: American soldier, lieutenant colonel in the Connecticut militia
died.cause: surrendering Fort Griswold during the Battle of Groton Heights. The British officer to whom Ledyard gave his sword in surrender immediately killed him with it
died.last_words: I did, sir, but you do now.

died.name: Arshadu'd-Dawla
died.cause: while being executed by firing squad for involvement in a plot to restore Mohammad Ali Shah Qajar to the Persian throne

died.name: Alfonso, Prince of Asturias
died.desc: former heir apparent to the throne of Spain
died.cause: dying of internal bleeding after car accident in Miami, Florida
died.last_words: ¡Mi madre! ¡Mi madre! Where is my mother? I'm all alone in this country. Don't leave me, Jack.

died.name: Edmund Gwenn
died.last_words: Dying is easy. Comedy is difficult.

died.name: Margaret Sanger
died.last_words: A party! Let's have a party.

died.name: Donald Henry Gaskins
died.last_words: I'll let my lawyers talk for me. I'm ready to go.

born.name: Catharine Beecher
born.last_words: I hope to be in Phil. in about ten days. I am stronger than for yrs. but take no new responsibilities.

born.name: Jereboam O. Beauchamp
born.cause: to his wife. Beauchamp had murdered Kentucky legislator Solomon P. Sharp to avenge his wife's honor. Beauchamp and his wife both stabbed themselves on the morning of his execution; his wife died of her wounds, while Beauchamp survived to be hanged
born.last_words: Farewell child of sorrow-Farewell child of misfortune and persecution-you are now secure from the tongue of slander-for you I have lived; for you I die.

born.name: Francis S. Bartow
born.desc: American and Confederate politician and brigade commander of the American Civil War
born.cause: mortally wounded at the First Battle of Bull Run
born.last_words: Boys, they've killed me, but never give it up!

born.name: Jane Addams
born.desc: American settlement and temperance activist, social worker and author
born.cause: when her physician asked if she wanted some water

born.name: Lorentzos Mavilis
born.cause: killed in action at the Battle of Driskos
born.last_words: I expected many honors from this war, but not the added honor that I offer my life for my Greece.
